$comment: Single source for the compiled format sets. scripts/assimp-builds-to-presets.mjs turns this into CMakePresets.json; the TypeScript ExportFormat union test and the docs format matrix read the same file. Adding a format the engine gained is one edit here. Ids are assimp's CMake format ids: a bare id in a list or in `disable` covers both ASSIMP_BUILD_<id>_IMPORTER and ASSIMP_BUILD_<id>_EXPORTER; an id ending in _IMPORTER or _EXPORTER covers only that side.

disable.$comment: Shared across production and native tests. M3D: undefined behaviour, crashes and leaks (assimp#4044) — importer and exporter (M3D_EXPORTER is listed explicitly because the exporter leak is a separate defect from the importer UB). RAW: assertion failure from a memory error. IRR/IRRMESH: XML parse failure. TERRAGEN: broken. PBRT/ASSBIN/ASSXML: not interchange formats (ASSBIN/ASSXML are assimp's own debug dumps). X, X3D, 3DS: removed from the product in 0.4 to cut size; VRML import is a front end to the X3D importer, so it goes with X3D. ASE keeps building: the engine fork decouples it from the 3DS importer switch.

cacheVariables.$comment: Applied to every build. ASSIMP_IGNORE_GIT_HASH keeps exporter bytes identical when a source archive has no .git directory. ASSIMP_BUILD_ZLIB builds zlib from source rather than probing the host. ASSIMP_BUILD_DRACO stays at assimp's own default (OFF): Draco support pulls a FetchContent dependency and costs size for a glTF sub-feature no consumer has asked for — recorded as a decision, revisit behind the size ratchets.

wasm.$comment: Everything the engine builds cleanly. USD and IFC each sit behind their own ASSIMP_BUILD_<X>_IMPORTER switch that ASSIMP_BUILD_ALL_IMPORTERS_BY_DEFAULT does not flip, and IFC additionally gates the web-ifc/glm include paths on it, so both have to be named. VRML is left off: it needs the X3D importer, which is disabled.

nativeTest.$comment: Host build for ctest. Importers the fixture subset needs, exporters the fixture subset writes; USD coverage stays only while the native CI job remains within OQ8's 15-minute ceiling.
